flows.name: admin complaints inbox
flows.title: Customer Complaints — মি. তুমি গ্রোসারি অ্যান্ড গিফট

flows.name: /admin/d7/settlements
flows.detail: No local MySQL connection/config; route returned 400 missing DB_NAME/DB_USER. No mutation attempted.

flows.name: /admin/d7/settings
flows.detail: No local MySQL connection/config; route returned 400 missing DB_NAME/DB_USER. No mutation attempted.

flows.name: browse/category/search/product details
flows.details: 24 search product links; product page and size variants rendered.

flows.name: customer registration/login/logout, history/cancellation/returns
flows.details: Local app is SQLite-only; registration POST returned HTTP 400 because customer auth requires MySQL; no customer account/order history/cancellation/return journey was possible.

flows.name: cart quantity and stock validation
flows.details: Browser checkout used quantity 2; isolated stock=1 fixture request for quantity 2 returned cart quantity 1. stock-validation.json.

flows.name: contact submission and admin inbox
flows.details: Contact message persisted and admin inbox rendered it.

flows.name: admin pending orders and inventory/ledger screens
flows.details: Pending order page and /admin/phase06 rendered at 360/390/768/1366. No stock/purchase mutation attempted.

flows.name: vendor portal screens
flows.details: Vendor logged in; orders/products/withdrawals rendered at all four widths.

flows.name: vendor fulfillment/commission/settlement actions
flows.details: Canonical item fulfillment and settlement repositories require MySQL. No action/payout attempted.

flows.name: reseller portal screens
flows.details: Reseller logged in; dashboard/orders/products/transactions/deposits/withdrawals rendered at all four widths.

flows.name: reseller financial/order actions
flows.details: SQLite mode does not provide the canonical financial workflows; no order/deposit/withdrawal mutation attempted.

flows.name: vendor product image upload chooser
flows.details: Browser selected one PNG in the file input; create-product form was not submitted.

flows.name: vendor/reseller/admin role isolation
flows.details: Independent vendor and reseller sessions redirected from sibling/admin portals to login; limited-support admin received 403. See cross-portal-security.json.

flows.name: admin return inspection/disposition and settlement
flows.details: D7 return handler reached but SQLite cannot serve it; settlements/settings lack local MySQL DB_NAME/DB_USER. No mutation attempted.

interactions.name: product variant selection
interactions.details: Real page radio selection changed from 500 g to 1 kg.

interactions.name: checkout quantity
interactions.details: Browser-posted checkout used quantity 2 and order confirmation showed two units at ৳2,600 subtotal.

interactions.name: browser modal and mobile drawer
interactions.details: With pinned Bootstrap 5.3.3 JS, mobile offcanvas shows backdrop and complaint modal toggles .show at 360 px.

interactions.name: upload field
interactions.details: Vendor create-product page accepted one PNG through the real file chooser API; form was not submitted and no product/file was persisted.

interactions.name: upload submission
interactions.details: No server upload was submitted to avoid creating fixture product/media artifacts; no production data touched.

externalAssetErrors: External assets outside the sandbox allowlist (Google fonts, chart/toast and provider CDN resources) could not be tested. Bootstrap 5.3.3 was locally served from its exact pinned npm package for the browser run.

follow_up_fixes.issue: SQLite-rendered checkout exposed active non-COD gateways and transfer fields.
follow_up_fixes.fix: COD-only UI; reject non-COD method or transfer references before order persistence.
follow_up_fixes.verification: Actual browser COD order confirmation; phase04 integration test rejects non-COD and confirms no order.

follow_up_fixes.issue: D7 returns/settlement/settings routes were unmapped and denied by the outer legacy RBAC layer.
follow_up_fixes.fix: Explicit returns review, settings, settlement prepare/approve policies; list GET uses either prepare or approve.
follow_up_fixes.verification: Dedicated policy regression tests pass; admin browser request now reaches D7 handler, then is blocked by unavailable MySQL.

follow_up_fixes.issue: At 768 px supplier form’s one-column submit button widened document to 802 px.
follow_up_fixes.verification: Initial real browser exposed 802px document width at 768px; after the fix, focused repeat measured document/body 768px with no overflow. Final viewport matrix updated accordingly.

post_fix_viewport_verification.source: repeat browser run after supplier form button wrapping correction
